name: Chapman Crafted Beer
tagline: Award-winning community craft brewery and taproom with patio games & food trucks
description: Born and raised in Old Towne Orange, Chapman Crafted Beer produces outstanding, clean, true-to-style craft lagers, juicy hazy IPAs, and barrel-aged stouts. The open-air industrial taproom welcomes locals, families, and pups with board games, shuffleboard, and rotating food trucks parked outside.
historicNote: Situated along the historic Santa Fe railroad spur in a repurposed 1940s packinghouse industrial facility.

specials.title: Mug Club & Locals Night
